subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw support for callback fields that are siblings of `action.value`?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the exact agent-facing shape affects channel message semantics and compatibility for existing button commands, so a maintainer should confirm the permanent payload contract before accepting the fix.

options.title: Structured additive payload
options.body: Review or replace the linked PR with a backward-compatible structured JSON payload for callbacks that include form/input/select fields while leaving simple button commands unchanged.

options.title: Narrow command-argument append
options.body: Only append selected form fields to the existing command-text path, reducing agent parser churn but losing a richer callback envelope.

options.title: Defer callback expansion
options.body: Keep only `action.value` support for now and leave form/select card actions unsupported until a broader Feishu interaction design is chosen.

recommendation.title: Structured additive payload
recommendation.body: Review or replace the linked PR with a backward-compatible structured JSON payload for callbacks that include form/input/select fields while leaving simple button commands unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history on Feishu card-action and monitor code paths and merged the latest adjacent Feishu refactor.
